captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a trailing-arm rear axle assembly with a torsion beam crossmember. It features a dark gray central torsion bar connecting two angled trailing arms, which terminate in cylindrical mounting bushings. At the outer ends, two black rubber tires are mounted on light gray metallic wheel hubs, which are attached via revolute joints to allow independent rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a trailing-arm rear axle with a torsion beam. The assembly should include a central crossmember, two trailing arms with cylindrical bushings, and two wheels on hubs mounted on revolute joints at the outer ends.
captions.factory: The code constructs the rear axle assembly by defining parts for the axle frame and the wheels. The main axle frame is built using cylinders for the central torsion beam, angled trailing arms, and mounting bushings. The wheels are created using concentric cylinders for the tires and hubs. These components are positioned using translation and rotation transforms, and the wheels are connected to the axle hubs using revolute articulations.
